result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations of integrals of the form $\int_0^\infty ds/(\sqrt{(t+s)(1+s)}(1+s))$ and their derivatives with respect to a parameter (a, t = cos y), evaluated via logarithms and trigonometric substitutions, apparently for the potential/equilibrium of a rotating fluid ellipsoid of revolution.
result.transcription:
$\frac{1+\sqrt{1-a^6}}{1-\sqrt{1-a^6}} = x^2$
$\frac{x^2-1}{x^2+1} = \sqrt{1-a^6}$
$1-\frac{(x^2-1)^2}{(x^2+1)^2} \quad a^3 = \frac{2x}{x^2+1}$
$\int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{(1+\frac{s}{a^2})(1+\frac{s}{a^2})(1+\frac{s}{c^2})}} \overset{c=a}{=} \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{[-\ldots-]}\,1+\frac{s}{a^2}} = \int_{\frac{1}{a^4}}^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{a^4 s}\;1-\frac{1}{a^6}+\frac{s}{a^2}} = \frac{1}{a\sqrt{[-\ldots-]}} \lg \frac{1+\sqrt{1-a^6}}{1-\sqrt{1-a^6}}$ $\quad \frac{1}{a^6} = (\cos y)^2$
$\int_0^\infty \frac{a\,\partial s}{\sqrt{1+a^4 s}\;1+\frac{s}{a^2}} = 2\,[-\ldots-]\frac{y}{\sin y} \quad \frac{1}{a^3} = \cos y$
$= f(a)$
$f(a) = [-\int_0^\infty \ldots-] = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{\frac{1}{a^6}+s}\;1+s} = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s\; a^3}{\sqrt{1+s}\; a^6+s}$
$p = \int \frac{\partial s\, a^2(\frac{1}{a^4}-a^2)s}{(1+[?]s)^{\frac{3}{2}}(1+\frac{s}{a^2})^2}$ $\quad \frac{\partial f a}{\partial \lg a} = 3\int_0^\infty \frac{a^{-6}\partial s}{(\frac{1}{a^6}+s)^{\frac{3}{2}}\;1+s} = 3\int \frac{a^{-3}\partial s}{(1+s)^{\frac{3}{2}}\;1+\frac{s}{a^6}}$
$= \frac{\partial f(a)}{\partial \lg a}$ $\quad \frac{\partial\left(a^3 \frac{\partial f(a)}{\partial \lg a}\right)}{\partial \lg a}$
$\partial(a^3\partial f a) = 3.6\int \frac{s\,\partial s\, a^{-6}}{(1+s)^{\frac{3}{2}}(1+\frac{s}{a^6})^2} = 3.6\cdot\int \frac{a^2 s\,\partial s}{(1+a^4 s)^{\frac{3}{2}}(1+\frac{s}{a^2})^2}$
$p = a^2(\frac{1}{a^6}-1)\frac{1}{3.6.}\partial a^3 \partial f(a)$ $\quad = 3.6\int \frac{a^6 s\,\partial s}{(1+a^6 s)^{\frac{3}{2}}(1+s)^2}$

$-3\,\partial \lg a = \frac{-\sin y\,\partial y}{\cos y}$
$\partial f(a) = \left(2\frac{1}{\sin y} - 2\frac{y\cos y}{(\sin y)^2}\right)\frac{3\cos y}{\sin y}$ $\quad a^3\partial f(a) = 3.2.\left(\frac{1}{(\sin y)^2} - \frac{y\cos y}{(\sin y)^3}\right)$
$\partial a^3\partial f(a) = [-\ldots-]\,3.2.\left(-3\frac{\cos y}{(\sin y)^3} - y\left(\frac{-\sin y}{(\sin y)^3} - 3\frac{(\cos y)^2}{(\sin y)^4}\right)\right)\frac{3\cos y}{\sin y}$
$f(t) = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{(t+s)}\;1+s} = \int_0^\infty \frac{t\,\partial s}{\sqrt{(1+s)}(1+ts)}$
$\frac{1}{a^3} = t = \cos y \qquad f(t) = \frac{2y}{u}$
$\frac{\partial t}{\partial y} = -\sin y = [-\ldots-]u \qquad \frac{\partial \lg t}{\partial y} = \frac{u}{t}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = t \qquad 1 = tt+uu$
$p = \frac{1}{2}a^2\,[-\ldots-]\,uu\,\partial t\,\partial f(t)$
$\frac{\partial p}{[-\ldots-]} = \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{\partial s\,(b^2-c^2)s^2}{\Delta\;1+\frac{s}{aa}\,(b^2+s)(c^2+s)} - [-\ldots-]\int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{(1+\frac{c^2}{a^2})s}{(a^2+s)(c^2+s)} = \int \frac{\partial s\, s^2\, a^3(\frac{1}{a^4}-a^2)}{(1+a^4 s)^{\frac{3}{2}}(1+\frac{s}{aa})^3} - \int \frac{2\partial s\,(1+s)\,a^{-4}}{(1+a^4 s)^{\frac{3}{2}}(1+\frac{s}{aa})^3}$
$\frac{\partial q}{\partial a} = \qquad + \qquad +$
$[-\ldots-]\partial\frac{1}{tt}\partial\frac{1}{t}f(t) = \int \frac{8t\,\partial s\, s^2}{\sqrt{1+s}\,(1+ts)^3} = \int \frac{8t^{-3}\partial s\, s^2}{\sqrt{t+s}\,(1+s)^3}$
$\partial\left(t^3\partial\frac{1}{tt}\partial\frac{1}{t}f(t)\right) = \int \frac{-8t\,\partial s\, s^2}{\sqrt{t+s}^{\,3}(1+s)^3}$
$\partial t f(t) = \int \frac{2t^{-2}\partial s}{\sqrt{1+s}\,(\frac{1}{t}+s)^2}$
$\partial\frac{1}{tt}\partial t f(t) = \int \frac{-8t\, s\,\partial s}{\sqrt{1+s}\,(1+ts)^3}$
[-$\partial tt\,\partial t f(t) = \int \frac{\ldots\partial s}{\sqrt{1+s}\,(\ldots)}$-]

methods.what: Substitution relating a^6 to an auxiliary variable x for evaluating the logarithmic integral
Closed-form evaluation of the ellipsoidal integral for b=a (spheroid) as a logarithm
Trigonometric form of the integral f(a) with 1/a^3 = cos y
Differentiation of f(a) with respect to log a under the integral sign
Expression of p in terms of derivatives of f(a)
Explicit trigonometric expressions for derivatives of f
Parametrisation t = cos y, u = sin y with f(t)=2y/u
Iterated derivative formulas for f(t) as integrals
